hints: Only one situation causes a crash: a right-moving cart somewhere to the left of a left-moving cart. Which cart does a new left-mover hit first?
Keep a stack of surviving carts. A new left-moving cart keeps fighting the right-moving cart on top of the stack until it dies or no right-mover is on top.

1. For each cart c, mark it alive.
  2. While alive, c < 0, and the top is positive: if the top is lighter than |c|, pop it and continue; if equal, pop it and c dies; if heavier, c dies.
  3. If c is still alive, push it.
  4. The stack, bottom to top, is the answer.

approaches.name: Brute force
approaches.idea: Repeatedly scan for adjacent right-then-left pairs, resolve them, and rebuild the list until nothing changes.

approaches.name: Optimal
approaches.idea: One pass with a stack of survivors; each cart is pushed and popped at most once.

explain: Take [6,-2,3,-8,4]. Push 6. Cart -2 meets 6, which is heavier, so -2 is destroyed. Push 3. Cart -8 destroys 3, then destroys 6, finds the stack empty and is pushed. Cart 4 moves right and is pushed. Result: [-8,4]. A left-mover with nothing (or only left-movers) on the stack is safe forever. Watch the equal-weight case: in [7,-7,-1] both 7s vanish and -1 survives.
recognize: Items moving in sequence where a new item can cancel several earlier ones → stack of survivors.
